text:
lauren.design: Quick design sync — need input on form validation patterns for the new Deployment settings flow. Fig update: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz

lauren.design: Two main questions: (1) inline errors on field blur vs only showing an error summary on submit? (2) confirmation patterns for destructive actions (single confirm modal vs typed-confirm). @maria.a11y @raj.engineering please weigh in.

raj.engineering: TL;DR — inline on blur + summary on submit seems pragmatic. Inline helps fast feedback, summary handles server-side errors.

raj.engineering: Implementation-wise we'll return {"field_errors": {"name": "required"}, "form_errors": ["quota exceeded"]} from API. Client can focus first field error and open a small error summary anchor at top.

sam.pm: agree with inline + summary. Also think we should avoid too many blocking messages during onboarding. Keep inline copy friendly. For destructive: typed-confirm for irreversible things (delete infra), simpler checkbox + confirm for soft resets.

maria.a11y: Accessibility points:
- Inline errors ok if each is linked via aria-describedby to the input.
- Use role="alert" for dynamic inline messages so SR announces them.
- Error summary must be focusable and receive focus on submit failure.
- Don't rely on color alone for error state, include icons/text.
- For required fields use explicit label text "(required)" and aria-required="true".

maria.a11y: Also suggest adding a short live region update when summary appears: "Form contains 3 errors" so screen reader users aren't lost.

nick.eng: Noted. We'll prototype: on blur validate client-side and show inline. On submit, collect client+server errors, render summary, then programmatically focus summary (and scroll). For typed-confirm we can use a small utility: confirmType('DELETE') modal with keyboard focus trap.

lauren.design: Draft microcopy options:
```
- Inline: "This field is required." (shown under field)
- Summary: "We couldn't save your changes. Please fix the errors below."
- Delete modal (typed): "Type DEPLOY to permanently delete this deployment."
- Soft reset modal: "This will reset settings to defaults. This action can be undone." [checkbox] "I understand"
```

sam.pm: Add telemetry: track how often typed-confirm stops users from proceeding and drop-off at modal. If typed-confirm causes high friction we can fall back to checkbox for some flows.

raj.engineering: I'll mock the interaction and push a small prototype branch. lauren, can you update Figma with the inline+summary states and include the confirm modal variants? @maria.a11y can you sign off on focus behavior once prototype is up?

maria.a11y: Yes, will test keyboard + NVDA/VoiceOver. :thumbsup:

lauren.design: Awesome — will update Figma and post link when ready. Thanks everyone!
